evals.prompt: A bright noir comedy in a bakery. The audience should enjoy seeing the baker conceal a missing pastry from an inspector. Give one compact direction.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Derives direction from audience complicity and concealment, preserving bright comedy.
Does not impose neon, fear acting, or first-listed genre defaults.
Returns one proposal without an unwanted alternatives exercise.

evals.prompt: Explore two ways to make first-time community-dinner guests feel welcome.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Provides two distinct central ideas or viewpoints, not palette swaps.
Connects each treatment to welcome and a concrete visible moment.
Explains a practical tradeoff without selecting or approving either.

evals.prompt: Only change our camera to a static wide shot. Keep the approved warm daylight, native ambience, and playful tone.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Changes the camera scope only and preserves accepted light, audio, and tone.
Does not demand reconfirmation of unrelated axes.

evals.prompt: A static poster of an open doorway. Viewers should feel invited. Genre undecided.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Uses visible design and invitation as its rationale.
Does not block on genre or require acting, camera movement, or narrative tactics.

evals.prompt: Give me the full Q&A for a short film where a quiet reunion feels awkward rather than sentimental.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Offers the opt-in detailed treatment while deriving choices from awkwardness.
Allows stillness and restrained performance rather than automatic escalation.
Recommendations remain proposed until accepted.

evals.prompt: Write one chat-only creative direction for a silent six-second lamp reveal. Keep the supplied product shape.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: No project file creation or mandatory audio/acting axis.
Proposes a feasible visible reveal tied to product fidelity.
States consequential missing information only if needed, without invented locks.

evals.prompt: A 20-second ad for a rooftop restaurant. Viewers should feel it is a destination worth dressing up for. Give one compact direction. Include camera and light planning and an energy level.
evals.expected_output: One compact treatment whose camera and light stance and energy level are tied to the intended reaction.
expectations: Names a camera stance and a light source, each tied to the destination feeling.
Names an energy level (restrained, standard or kinetic).
Does not default to static wide shots or mood words alone, and gives a reason for any static choice.
Returns one proposal without an unwanted alternatives exercise.

evals.prompt: A selfie-style demo ad: a creator holds the phone at arm's length and shows how to use a pocket blender. Give one compact direction. Include a lighting stance.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate direction that treats the locked selfie frame as the format and puts variety in light, props and demonstration beats.
expectations: Recognizes the selfie frame as static by design and preserves that format.
Does not impose a crane, orbit or whip pan on the selfie frame.
Still names a light stance and the beats of the demonstration.

evals.prompt: I have confirmed the concept. Revise only the energy level to restrained, keeping all camera and lighting locks unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A scoped energy proposal preserving all existing locks.
expectations: Changes only the requested energy stance.
Does not propose a new camera or light setup.
Does not infer approval from silence or use agent-confirmed locks.

evals.prompt: Brief: adapt the opening test scene of a classic science-fiction novel, where an old woman tests a boy with a box that causes pain. We have the novel's text. Keep it cinematic and faithful.
evals.expected_output: A compact proposal that says where the pain lives instead of VFX, treats the novel as the source bible, and names a quality bar.
expectations: It says where the feeling lives (performance, sound, light, framing) rather than relying on literal effects for the pain.
It treats the novel as a source bible and lists lines or details that must survive later stages.
It names a quality bar or asks whose reaction it is only if the brief cannot answer it.
It does not turn the questions into a long questionnaire, and it still gives a camera and light stance with an energy level.

evals.prompt: Shape a chat-only brief borrowing the rhythm of this reference ad. The caller can inspect local video but cannot hear audio. A permitted audio-analysis tool is available; no local transcription tool is installed.
evals.expected_output: A scoped brief with a capability-driven reference-analysis handoff, without this leaf fetching media or invoking tools.
expectations: Hands full reverse-engineering to template-factory and requires actual visual evidence, not the ad's article or script.
Prefers capable native visual inspection without requiring an upload.
Allows the caller's permitted audio-capable fallback without requiring local transcription installation.
Does not infer audible rhythm from picture cuts or treat the recipe as generation authorization.

evals.prompt: Make a new 12-second video: someone gets a rejection and tells a friend {I'm fine.}. Make it emotional. Nothing else is decided. Chat only; do not generate.
evals.expected_output: A focused premise question with distinct proposed readings where useful, not an invented approved scene.
expectations: Clarifies intended audience response, what carries attention and why the ending matters before treating the premise as settled.
May contrast ending the friend's questions with sincere reassurance, labeling both as proposed rather than inventing motive or canon.
Keeps the exact line and proposes early sound or silence and edit intent only as a proportionate chat handoff.
Suggests observable acceptance, such as the listener's response surviving the ending, without claiming playback evidence.
Does not require a document, saved plan, whole-scene workflow, automatic review or generation.

evals.prompt: Write one compact chat direction for first-time visitors: a silent eight-second community-dinner film. The viewer notices an empty chair while people make room, and the ending holds that invitation open. Keep the held wide and silence; no alternatives.
evals.expected_output: A complete supplied premise carried into one proportionate direction without reopening settled choices.
expectations: Uses welcome as audience response, making room as attention, and the open invitation as the ending's purpose.
Keeps silence and the held wide without adding a score, cut, gesture quota or twist.
Suggests checking that the chair and space-making remain readable through the held ending.
Does not offer alternatives, ask redundant premise questions or create files.

evals.prompt: New moving-image project, no brief text yet. I only know it should be memorable. Do not choose a product, audience, plot or ending for me.
evals.expected_output: A compact clarification of missing audience, response and intended content, without fabricating a premise or a finished prompt.
expectations: Treats empty material intent as unresolved and asks what is being made and for whom.
Explains that attention and ending need purpose rather than inserting a wow shot or compulsory reversal.
No invented claims, approval, media evidence, files or automatic review.

evals.prompt: Settled prompt edit only: replace 'red parcel' with 'blue parcel'. Keep every action, word, shot, ending and sound cue. Return inline.
evals.expected_output: Only the requested color change, without a fresh creative-premise exercise.
expectations: Does not reopen audience, attention or ending decisions or add alternatives.
Preserves all action, dialogue, timing and sound, and returns chat only.
No automatic review, registry, save or generation.
